title: THAT ALL THE EARTH MIGHT KNOW

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "For the Lord your God dried up the Jordan before you until you had crossed over. The Lord your God did to the Jordan what he had done to the Red Sea when he dried it up before us until we had crossed over. He did this so that all the peoples of the earth might know that the hand of the Lord is powerful and so that you might always fear the Lord your God." — Josh 4:23-24 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Joshua closes by lifting our eyes to the two great reasons behind the miracle. First: "so that all the peoples of the earth might know that the hand of the Lord is powerful." God's saving acts were never meant to stay hidden within Israel. They were a witness to the watching nations, a declaration to the whole world that Israel's God is the true and mighty God. God's purposes have always reached beyond one people toward all the peoples of the earth.

Second: "so that you might always fear the Lord your God." The miracle was meant to produce reverent, worshipful awe in God's people — not a cringing terror, but a deep, loving respect that shapes how they live. When we truly grasp God's power, it settles into a holy fear that keeps us humble and obedient.

Notice how Joshua links the Jordan to the Red Sea. The same God who saved the previous generation saved this one. God's faithfulness runs unbroken from one generation to the next. What He did for our parents, He does for us.

This global purpose finds its fullest expression in the gospel. Through Christ, God's saving power is proclaimed to "all the peoples of the earth," calling every nation to know Him and reverence Him (Matt 28:19). The Jordan crossing was one chapter in God's great plan to make Himself known to the whole world — a plan that finds its centre and climax in Jesus.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do you see God's work in your life as a witness to others, not just a private blessing?
2. Does a healthy "fear of the Lord" — reverent awe — shape how you live?
3. How does God's heart for "all the peoples of the earth" stir you to share His grace?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, let Your work in my life be a witness to others of Your power. Fill me with reverent awe of You, and give me a heart for all the peoples of the earth to know You. Amen.
